| Metric | Value | Benchmark |

| Driver | Impact |
|--------|--------|
| **AWS Expansion** | Continues to be the most profitable segment; projected to grow 15–20 % YoY. |
| **International Market Penetration** | Amazon’s global e‑commerce footprint is expanding, especially in India and Southeast Asia. |

| Risk | Description |
|------|-------------|

| **Interest Rate Sensitivity** | Higher rates may reduce consumer spending on discretionary items and increase borrowing costs. |
